The Problem

Tired of juggling 6 different contractors?

Most HOA boards and property owners spend hours every month coordinating separate vendors for HVAC, landscaping, tech, and repairs — with no accountability when something goes wrong. Managed Property Systems replaces all of them with one local team, one contract, and one monthly report.

No Accountability

When something breaks, every vendor points the finger at someone else. You're stuck in the middle.

Budget Surprises

Unpredictable invoices from multiple contractors make budgeting a guessing game.

No-Show Vendors

Missed appointments and radio silence when you need someone most — especially in emergencies.

Our Services

Everything Your Property Needs. One Team.

HVAC & Refrigerant

EPA Level II certified maintenance and emergency response. Quarterly PM plans keep systems running through Florida's brutal summers.

Security & Low Voltage

Camera systems, access control, smart locks, and intercom installation and support. Complete visibility and control for your property.

Landscaping & Grounds

Weekly lawn care, bed maintenance, irrigation checks, and seasonal cleanup. Your curb appeal, handled.

Storm & Environmental

Pre-storm preparation, post-storm priority response, and insurance documentation. We're ready before the forecast says to worry.

IT & WiFi Infrastructure

Property-wide WiFi, guest networks for STRs, and remote monitoring. Connectivity that just works.

Property Inspections

Monthly photo inspection reports delivered to your inbox. Transparent documentation your HOA board or insurer can rely on.
